title: VaR and expected shortfall for a discrete loss distribution
prompt: Losses are positive for losses and negative for gains. VaR at alpha is inf{x: P(loss<=x)>=alpha}; ES is the mean of the worst 1-alpha probability mass, taking only the necessary fraction of any boundary atom. For this one-day portfolio, report 90% VaR, 90% ES, and the unconditional probability mass taken from the loss-4 scenario into ES. Amounts are USD million.

outputs.name: boundary_mass
outputs.description: Unconditional mass used from the loss-4 atom.
